001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.ICause;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
011import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
012import org.clafer.common.Util;
013
014/**
015 * Idempotent version of the one provided by the Choco library.
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropSetUnion extends Propagator<SetVar> {
020
021    private final SetVar[] sets;
022    private final ISetDeltaMonitor[] setsD;
023    private final SetVar union;
024    private final ISetDeltaMonitor unionD;
025
026    public PropSetUnion(SetVar[] sets, SetVar union) {
027        super(Util.cons(union, sets), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
028        this.sets = sets;
029        this.setsD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(sets, this);
030        this.union = union;
031        this.unionD = union.monitorDelta(this);
032    }
033
034    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
035        return idx >= 1;
036    }
037
038    private int getSetVarIndex(int idx) {
039        assert isSetVar(idx);
040        return idx - 1;
041    }
042
043    private boolean isUnionVar(int idx) {
044        return idx == 0;
045    }
046
047    @Override
048    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
049        return SetEventType.all();
050    }
051
052    private void findMate(int unionEnv) throws ContradictionException {
053        boolean inKer = union.getLB().contains(unionEnv);
054        int mate = -1;
055        for (int j = 0; j < sets.length; j++) {
056            if (sets[j].getUB().contains(unionEnv)) {
057                // Found a second mate.
058                if (mate != -1 || !inKer) {
059                    mate = -2;
060                    break;
061                }
062                mate = j;
063            }
064        }
065        if (mate == -1) {
066            // No mates.
067            union.remove(unionEnv, this);
068        } else if (mate != -2 && inKer) {
069            // One mate.
070            sets[mate].force(unionEnv, this);
071        }
072    }
073
074    private static boolean isKerSubsetEnvs(SetVar set, SetVar[] envs) {
075        ISetIterator iter = set.getLB().iterator();
076        while (iter.hasNext()) {
077            int i = iter.nextInt();
078            if (!PropUtil.envsContain(envs, i)) {
079                return false;
080            }
081        }
082        return true;
083    }
084
085    private static void envSubsetEnvs(SetVar set, SetVar[] envs, ICause propagator) throws ContradictionException {
086        ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
087        while (iter.hasNext()) {
088            int i = iter.nextInt();
089            if (!PropUtil.envsContain(envs, i)) {
090                set.remove(i, propagator);
091            }
092        }
093    }
094
095    @Override
096    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
097        for (SetVar set : sets) {
098            PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(set, union, this);
099            PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(set, union, this);
100        }
101        envSubsetEnvs(union, sets, this);
102        ISetIterator iter = union.getUB().iterator();
103        while (iter.hasNext()) {
104            findMate(iter.nextInt());
105        }
106        PropUtil.startMonitoring(setsD);
107        unionD.startMonitoring();
108    }
109
110    @Override
111    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
112        if (isSetVar(idxVarInProp)) {
113            int id = getSetVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
114            setsD[id].forEach(this::pruneUnionOnSetEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
115            setsD[id].forEach(this::pickUnionOnSetKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
116        } else {
117            assert isUnionVar(idxVarInProp);
118            unionD.forEach(this::pruneSetOnUnionEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
119            unionD.forEach(this::pickSetOnUnionKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
120        }
121    }
122
123    private void pruneUnionOnSetEnv(int setEnv) throws ContradictionException {
124        findMate(setEnv);
125    }
126
127    private void pickUnionOnSetKer(int setKer) throws ContradictionException {
128        union.force(setKer, this);
129    }
130
131    private void pruneSetOnUnionEnv(int unionEnv) throws ContradictionException {
132        for (SetVar set : sets) {
133            set.remove(unionEnv, this);
134        }
135    }
136
137    private void pickSetOnUnionKer(int unionKer) throws ContradictionException {
138        findMate(unionKer);
139    }
140
141    @Override
142    public ESat isEntailed() {
143        boolean allInstantiated = true;
144        for (SetVar set : sets) {
145            if (!PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(set, union)) {
146                return ESat.FALSE;
147            }
148            allInstantiated = allInstantiated && set.isInstantiated();
149        }
150        if (!isKerSubsetEnvs(union, sets)) {
151            return ESat.FALSE;
152        }
153        allInstantiated = allInstantiated && union.isInstantiated();
154        return allInstantiated ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
155    }
156
157    @Override
158    public String toString() {
159        return Util.intercalate(" ∪ ", sets) + " = " + union;
160    }
161}
